answer: Edge-Concentration Scoring. Each agent’s standing derives from the diversity of distinct subnets reaching it, not the count of links. Enforcement: arrivals confined to one neighborhood yield a weak signal and are throttled at routing. Honest agents accrue cross-cluster paths that widen over time into a spiral of trust. An attacker must rent genuinely independent regions and sustain traffic long enough to keep each ember of standing alive; spoofed adjacent peers collapse into one cluster and count once, making each effective identity cost real infrastructure and months of steady interaction.
